article.headline: Todd's 21 help Arkansas State down Troy 84-78
article.description: — Taryn Todd scored 21 points as Arkansas State beat Troy 84-78 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Todd's 21 help Arkansas State down Troy 84-78
article.story: TROY, Ala. -- — Taryn Todd scored 21 points as Arkansas State beat Troy 84-78 on Saturday night. Todd had seven rebounds for the Red Wolves (12-5, 3-2 Sun Belt Conference). Joseph Pinion scored 17 points, shooting 5 for 10, including 5 for 9 from beyond the arc. Terrance Ford Jr. shot 5 of 7 from the field and 4 for 4 from the line to finish with 15 points, while adding eight assists. Tayton Conerway finished with 32 points, seven assists and four steals for the Trojans (10-6, 3-2). Theo Seng added 18 points and two blocks for Troy. NEXT UP Up next for Arkansas State is a matchup Thursday with Louisiana at home. Troy visits UL Monroe on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
